```{r setup}
library(dplyr)
library(glue)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
theme_set(theme_bw)
```

```{r read}
dat <- read_tsv(params$atac_rna_logfc) 
```
```{r plot_corr}
dat %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = log2FoldChange_atac, y = log2FoldChange_rna)) + 
  geom_point()
```
